speak.title: Role-play: choosing a summer holiday
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: the friend who wants a cool holiday
a.text: You want to spend a week in Norway or Scotland this summer. You hate very hot weather and sleep badly when it is hot. Try to persuade your friend.

b.role: the friend who wants a beach holiday
b.text: You want a week in Spain. You love sunshine and swimming. Explain why, and listen to your friend's ideas. Try to agree on a plan.

phrases: I can't sleep when it's too hot.
That's a fair point, but I love the beach.
What if we went in May instead?
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: where did you decide to go, and who gave way more?
